titulo.en: Cheer up, you can do it!

intro.en: Calming someone down, comforting them, encouraging them and offering your help.

rendirse.nota: E becomes i: no te rindas.

texto.en:
**Calming.** Reflexive imperatives: **Tranquilízate.** **Cálmate.** **Relájate.** Or just the adjective: **Tranquilo, hombre.** **Tranquila, mujer.** Here **hombre** and **mujer** add warmth, nothing else.

Negative commands, with the subjunctive: **No te preocupes.** **No llores.** **No te pongas así.**

**Comforting.** The future and **seguro que**:

- **Ya está.** **Ya ha pasado.**
- **Seguro que no es nada.**
- **Seguro que todo se arreglará.**
- **Todo saldrá bien.**
- **Todo tiene solución.**

**Encouraging.**

- **¡Venga!** **¡Vamos!** **¡Ánimo!** **¡Anímate!**
- **No tengas miedo de** preguntar.
- **No hay nada que temer.**
- **Sigue intentándolo.**
- **No te rindas.**
- **Tú puedes.** **Lo conseguirás.**
- **¡Atrévete!**

**Offering help.** At B1: **¿Quieres que te ayude?** Now also:

- **¿Te echo una mano?**
- **¿Necesitas que** te **lleve**?
- **Deja que te ayude.** / **Déjame que te ayude.**
- **Déjame a mí.** (when you take over)
- **Permita que la ayude.** (formal)

frases.es: No puedo, de verdad. Voy a suspender otra vez.
frases.en: I can't, really. I'm going to fail again.

frases.es: Tranquila, mujer. No te pongas así. Seguro que todo saldrá bien.
frases.en: Calm down, dear. Don't get like that. I'm sure everything will turn out fine.

frases.es: Es que la última vez me puse tan nerviosa que se me caló el coche tres veces.
frases.en: The thing is, last time I got so nervous that I stalled the car three times.

frases.es: Ya ha pasado. Has practicado mucho y conduces muy bien. No hay nada que temer.
frases.en: That's over. You've practised a lot and you drive very well. There's nothing to fear.
And what if I fail again?

frases.es: Pues sigues intentándolo. No te rindas. ¡Ánimo, que tú puedes! Deja que te lleve yo al examen.
frases.en: Then you keep trying. Don't give up. Come on, you can do it! Let me take you to the test.

rindas.en: A negative command takes the subjunctive: e becomes i.

rindes.en: A negative command takes the subjunctive.

ayudar.en: With que you need a conjugated verb.

pregunta.en: In Tranquilo, hombre, the word hombre…

adds warmth.en: It is a friendly filler, not a description.

means the listener must be a man.en: Mujer is used the same way for women, but both are just fillers.

texto.en: I'm sure everything will sort itself out.
It is safe to repair everything.

explicacion.en: Seguro que: I'm sure that. Arreglarse: to sort itself out.
Arreglarse here is about a problem.

pregunta.en: You take a heavy bag from someone's hands. You say…

No te pongas así..en: That calms someone who is upset.

pregunta.en: Which phrase encourages someone to take a risk?

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a message of encouragement to a friend who has failed an important exam.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Calm down and encourage aloud a friend who is very nervous before an interview.
